svg.title: Actual projected rHEALPix cells at resolutions zero, one and two
svg.text: The implemented rHEALPix grid in projected metres
resolution 2 inside face Q · actual projected cell boundaries
Q38 is highlighted in gold; its resolution-3 child Q381 is coral.
Coordinates and polygons come directly from Cell.boundary(plane=True); no illustrative grid geometry is substituted.
